title: scene-server: SceneObject create omits normalized orientation from created
description: RFC 8620 §5.3: the created entry holds 'any properties that were omitted or not set to the requested value by the server'. crate-jmap-scene-server/src/object.rs create_scene_object normalizes orientation (draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 6bcd9d8 L196) and defaults an absent one to identity, but returns only id/ownerId/createdAt/updatedAt. SceneRegion create now echoes a normalized spawnOrientation (JMAP-38uq.11). Found while implementing JMAP-38uq.11.
